relations.text: 最大の調達先(都市ガス部門の購入量の21%)
relations.text_en: Largest supplier: 21% of utility gas purchases

source.label: National Fuel Gas 10-K(2026年9月期)
source.quote: Purchases from DTE Energy Trading, Inc. (21%), Expand Energy Marketing, LLC (14%), Emera Energy Services, Inc.
